en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned panoramic view over a historic European city filled with dense low-roofed houses and church towers. The photo is taken from an elevated hillside with rocky foreground. On the right side, a large crucifix with the figure of Jesus dominates the foreground, overlooking the city below. The back of the card has standard postcard layout with address lines, stamp boxes, and printed caption text in Hungarian and English.
